description: Put 3D models in someone's real room: generate, arrange, and hand back one AR link.
name: io.github.nirholas/3d-ar-studio

environmentVariables.description: The page that composed AR scenes link to. Defaults to the hosted demo; set it to your own deployment of the studio.
environmentVariables.name: AR_STUDIO_PAGE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Catalogue URL that search_models searches. Defaults to the free CC0 model library.
environmentVariables.name: AR_STUDIO_ASSETS

environmentVariables.description: MCP endpoint used for text-to-3D generation. Defaults to the free, keyless three.ws 3D Studio connector.
environmentVariables.name: AR_STUDIO_MCP_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Origin serving the hosted 'View in your space' launcher and the 3D viewer. Defaults to https://three.ws.
environmentVariables.name: AR_STUDIO_ORIGIN

title: 3D AR Studio
